description_en: Queries the lineage of a metatable
description_zh: 调用GetMetaTableLineage获取表的血缘关系
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public get-meta-table-lineage --table-guid odps.engine_name.table_name --direction up --next-primary-key next_primary_key --page-size 10 --cluster-id abc --database-name abc --table-name abc --data-source-type emr --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMetaTableLineage

parameters.description_en: The unique identifier of the table.
parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the table
parameters.name: table_guid

parameters.description_en: Specifies the ancestor or descendant lineage that you want to query for a field. Valid values: up and down. The value up indicates the ancestor lineage. The value down indicates the descendant lineage.
parameters.description_zh: 字段的上下游方向：up表示上游，down表示下游。
parameters.help_en: Specifies the ancestor or descendant lineage that you want to query for a field. Valid values: up and down. The value up indicates the ancestor lineage. The value down indicates the descendant lineage

parameters.name: direction

parameters.description_en: The logic of paging. Configure this parameter based on the value of the response parameter NextPrimaryKey when the value of the response parameter HasNext is true in the previous request.
parameters.description_zh:
分页的逻辑。
